cover.note: House 3's gate on a grey winter morning: a messenger hands an order slip to a clerk under the portico; behind, a loader lifts a grain sack beside the board of numbered slots.

scene.prompt: Turn [image 1], a rough 3D blockout, into a photorealistic photograph with the same camera, composition and landforms: looking along the portico of a Hellenistic Greek trading house on a stone quay: on the left the house's lime-plastered wall, off-white over a low rubble base, overhead timber beams under a lean-to roof of pan and cover tiles, on the right plain Doric columns with no bases and the sea. Winter overcast, soft flat light, cloud low on the hills. [image 2] is a reference board: copy its messenger and pouch exactly. Under the portico the bare-headed messenger hands a small folded papyrus slip to a clerk in a plain grey-blue tunic holding a wax tablet. Behind them on the portico wall, a long timber board with a row of open wooden slots, each marked with a Greek letter-numeral (Α, Β, Γ, Δ…), never Arabic digits, some holding small clay tablets, a short wooden peg standing in one slot; beside it a loader in a coarse brown tunic lifts a grain sack. No other people. Nothing modern.

b01-goatherd.note: The goatherd on a track high on the spur above House 2's harbour, pointing down to the port; the cliff road round the bay below.

scene.prompt: Turn [image 1], a rough 3D blockout, into a photorealistic photograph with the same camera, composition and landforms: a small Hellenistic Greek port town of stone houses with terracotta roofs below a steep hillside, a long stone pier in the harbour, the sea beyond. Replace every smooth placeholder shape with real maquis, pine, rock, stone and roof tile. The buildings are modelled: keep every building's shape, roof, doors and windows where they are, with whitewashed plaster walls on a low rubble base under terracotta pan-and-cover tile roofs, and earth streets. Winter late morning overcast, cloud low on the hills: soft flat light. In the foreground on a narrow stony goat track among the scrub: a weathered goatherd in a rough undyed wool tunic and a sheepskin cape, holding a crook, with four or five goats around him, pointing down toward the town. Below, a narrow road cut into the hillside runs round the bay into the town. Deep focus, all sharp. No other people. Nothing modern.

b08-board.note: Herlios' board under the portico at House 3's gate: numbered slots, the peg, two clerks reaching for slots, a loader walking the row.

scene.prompt: Turn [image 1], a 3D model, into a photorealistic photograph with exactly the same camera, composition and architecture: looking along the portico of a Hellenistic Greek trading house on a stone quay. On the left the house's lime-plastered wall, off-white over a low rubble base; overhead timber beams under a lean-to roof of pan and cover tiles; on the right plain Doric columns without bases and the sea beyond; ahead a timber storehouse door standing open and grain sacks. Real weathered plaster, stone, timber and tile. Winter overcast, soft flat light. On the wall, the long timber board at chest height: a row of twelve open wooden slots, each marked with a painted Greek letter-numeral (Α, Β, Γ, Δ…), never Arabic digits; the first five hold small clay tablets, and a short wooden peg stands beside them. Two clerks, one in a grey-blue tunic and one in an olive tunic, reach for neighbouring slots at once; a loader in a coarse brown tunic walks towards us along the portico with a grain sack on his shoulder.
